title: J'ay pris amours / De tous biens plaine (Jaspart)
desc: Jaspart, attributed to Japart, Jean, J'ay pris amours / De tous biens plaine. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0509), edited by Paul Kolb (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. V. Settings of Liturgical Texts, Songs, and Instrumental Works, 2020); encoded by Karina Zybina. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
